strongest_angle: Archivist Chris Olver spent nine months cataloguing the newly unveiled personal archive of The Snowman creator Raymond Briggs at The Keep in Brighton.

key_facts.fact: Archivist Chris Olver spent nine months cataloguing the personal papers, work, and records of Raymond Briggs at The Keep.
The personal archive of Raymond Briggs is held by the East Sussex and Brighton and Hove Record Office at The Keep.
The cataloguing project for the Raymond Briggs archive was funded by The National Archives Archives Revealed Cataloguing Grant.
The cataloguing project for the Raymond Briggs archive began in January 2026 with the appointment of archivist Chris Olver.

quotes.text: Dealing with a new archive of items belonging to The Snowman illustrator Raymond Briggs "felt a bit like going into Tutankhamun's tomb", according to an archivist who worked on the project.
quotes.speaker: Chris Olver

named_entities.name: East Sussex and Brighton and Hove Record Office
